title: Version-stamped deploy and Beta release titles
summary: Cloudron deploy now stamps GitHub Deployments, publishes GitHub Releases automatically, and uses the display title format {VERSION} Beta for deployments and releases.
changes: Automate Cloudron deploy GitHub Release publishing on successful deploy with notes from scripts/deploy/github-release-notes.sh.
Set deployment description and GitHub Release display name to {VERSION} Beta; keep tags as v{VERSION}.
Change workflow run-name to {VERSION} Beta without a Deploy prefix.
Add scripts/github/rename-release-titles.sh and scripts/github/migrate-beta-milestones.sh for release title and milestone migration.
affected_areas: Agent ship-gate and issue milestone guidance
version_rationale: Patch release: deployment and release automation plus display-title correction; no end-user product behaviour change.
validation: php artisan myapes:changelog-prepare --type=patch with --issue and --pr before merge.
DeploymentAuthenticationContractTest covers RELEASE_DISPLAY_TITLE and publish-github-release workflow contracts.
bash scripts/github/rename-release-titles.sh supports --dry-run idempotent title edits.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main after filling release notes.
known_limitations: Past deployment records cannot be renamed via the GitHub API; only future deploys show the new title.
Run scripts/github/rename-release-titles.sh once with admin gh auth to fix existing release display titles.
Run scripts/github/migrate-beta-milestones.sh with repo admin access to rename milestones.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. To remove version-stamped releases, revert deploy-cloudron.yml, ship-gate docs, and the helper scripts from this release.
provenance: Defined by version-stamped deploys, releases, and Beta milestones for MyAPES Account issue #183.
